title: Positive: API stays error-free under local load up to 200 concurrent clients
expected: No errors under load; latency degrades gracefully.
actual: 0 errors at 10/50/100/200 concurrent clients. Throughput plateaus at ≈ 3,100 rps (/health), 1,100–1,400 rps (products, businesses lists) and ≈ 850 rps (trending); p99 at 200 clients 99–279 ms, rising linearly — a single CPU-bound Node process. Caveats: 4-vCPU sandbox vs a fraction of one CPU on Render free; small dataset (13 products, 7 businesses); dev runtime. Treat as an upper bound; soak and spike tests not run.
impact: No code bottleneck at this scale; hosting plan is the limit (see F-030).
fix: Re-run against staging with production-size data and the real plan; add Node clustering or a second instance with Redis-backed rate limits before growth.
